newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian coffee temperature and rain detailed.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian coffee temperature and rain detailed.

text.p: Brazilian coffee region temperatures (centigrade) and rain (millimeters) in the 72 hours to 1200 GMT.
Parana State: Londrina 20.2, 63.0 MM, maringa 21.6, 7.0 mm, Umuarama Not Available, Paranavai 21.9, 25.1 mm.
Sao Paulo State: Presidente Prudente 22.4, 5.5 mm, Franca 18.8, 7.3 mm, Votuporanga 22.7, 5.8 mm, Catanduva 20.8, 9.5 mm, Sao Carlos 17.0, 89 mm, Simao 18.5, 17.1 mm.
Minas Gerais State: Pocos de Caldas 15.0, 51.0 mm, Guaxupe 16.2, 39.0 mm.
